'''Stefanie Dittman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Pleasanton tournament]] on 3 March 2001 with RST, according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1845">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pleasanton-north-california-3-3-01d1845/ pleasanton-north-california-3-3-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pleasanton-north-california-3-3-01d1845/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
